subject: Runway tiling & clearance — LumosAI late-stage POC capacity request
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runway tiling & clearance — LumosAI late-stage POC capacity request

Team —

LumosAI (Sara) just signaled they want to move their POC to a scaled late-stage run. High level ask: 8xA100-equivalent sustained for ~6 weeks starting the week of 2026-09-18, with peak sustain windows (4 hour windows, 2x/day) and KV-cache friendly workloads. They will be billed as Dedicated if we can provision.

Before I commit anything externally I need a quick sanity/availability check and an ask to put a short soft hold on the capacity runway for the proposed start window. This is late-stage — we don't want to promise without ops confirmation. Specifics:
- Nominal requirement: 8 GPUs (A100-class) concurrently, tolerant to quantized variants (int8) if we recommend avoiding 4-bit for quality.
- Duration: 6 weeks (estimated), start 2026-09-18
- Region: us-west (preferred), fallback us-east
- SLAs: low-latency 95th p50 target ~120ms for batches <= 8 tokens.

Can you each reply with: immediate availability (yes/no), suggested mitigation if not available (e.g., time-shift, mixed-quantization, augment with pre-warmed burst pool), and whether we can place a 21-day soft hold for LumosAI while legal finalizes the MPA?

I attached the Lumos POC spec that Sara shared and a quick snapshot request for fleet sizing.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachments: LumosAI_POC_spec_v2.xlsx (xlsx), fleet_snapshot_20260805.csv (csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway tiling & clearance — LumosAI late-stage POC capacity request

Mateo —

Quick read-through. Short answer: possible but tight in us-west for mid-Sep. Notes from infra sizing:
- 8 A100-equivalents maps to either 8xA100-40GB or 12xA5000-quantized (approx) depending on model footprint. Which model family are they running? If it's a 13B-class dense model, plan for the 8xA100.
- We have a scheduled maintenance window for cluster w-3 (us-west) on 2026-09-20 that could impact a one-week ramp; if they can start 09/18 we should mark a migration contingency.
- Mitigations: warm KV-prefill plus prefix caching will shave peak cost and reduce burst pressure; recommend enabling intelligent batching with max batch=4 and burst pool fallback to dedicated extra nodes.

Soft hold: ops can carve out a provisional reservation for 14 days from booking request; 21 days is doable but requires engineering approval to reserve burst pool.

Action items:
- Mateo: confirm exact model (name + sequence length expectation) and peak concurrency pattern.
- Ben/Grace: ops lead to validate burst pool carve-out policy and post-maintenance capacity delta.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Eng

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-05T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway tiling & clearance — LumosAI late-stage POC capacity request

Looping operational readiness notes in one place.

Availability snapshot (quick, as of 8/05):
- us-west dedicated pool: currently 64 A100-eq free hours daily; can support an 8-GPU sustained for phased ramp but not if they need 24/7 immediate start on 09/18.
- Burst pool (shared): has capacity to support daily peak windows but we restrict long running reservation to avoid blocking other near-term deals.

Proposal for internal approval:
1) Place a 14-day provisional soft hold starting today for the target window (09/18 start). This will earmark node slices and flag the deal in our internal bookings dashboard.
2) Condition the hold on receipt of signed MPA term sheet (I attached our recommended MPA term sheet with deposit clause).
3) If LumosAI needs firm 24/7 capacity for the 6-week run, move to a reserved contract (Dedicated) with a ramp schedule — ops will need 72 hrs to carve and test capacity post-MPA.

Attachments: MPA_term_sheet_LumosAI.pdf (pdf) — redlined section on deposit and activation timelines.

If everyone agrees I'll file the provisional hold ticket and include a migration contingency that Karthik noted. Grace — can you initiate the hold ticket and tag it priority P2?

—Ben
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Sara Liu <sara@lumosai.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-06T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runway tiling & clearance — LumosAI late-stage POC capacity request

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the timeline internally and can accept a 09/21 start if needed; the 09/18 slot was aspirational. We are prepared to sign the MPA term sheet with the deposit clause (attached) once Redwood confirms a provisional hold. Can you confirm the hold window and whether you need the signed MPA to activate the reservation? Also, please confirm whether us-east is supported as a fallback — some of our devs are east coast.

High-level: 8 A100-class or equivalent is accurate; model is a tuned 13B, 2-4k token windows on peak. We prefer us-west but ok with us-east fallback.

Sara Liu
Head of ML Ops | LumosAI

Attachment referenced: Lumos_MPA_signed_draft.pdf (pdf, will send once hold confirmed)

- LumosAI confirmed model details (13B, 2-4k token windows) and is OK to slip to 09/21 if needed.
- Ben, good to place a 14-day provisional soft hold for the 09/21-10/05 ramp window conditioned on receipt of signed MPA. Please tag as Deal DL-4982 and priority P2.
- Karthik, please add a migration contingency for the 09/20 maintenance and confirm fallback plan to us-east with estimated latency delta.
- Grace, file the hold ticket and include attachment pointers: fleet_snapshot_20260805.csv and MPA_term_sheet_LumosAI.pdf.

I'll confirm back to Sara once the hold ticket is in the system.

Mateo
